description: This file defines a Blazor component helper class 'BlazorComponent' that extends ComponentBase and manages refresh behavior via a singleton 'RefreshBroadcast'. It overrides the initialization process and provides methods to trigger and respond to refresh requests.

classes.name: BlazorComponent
classes.description: A helper Blazor component class that manages refresh requests via a broadcast mechanism.

methods.name: OnInitialized
methods.description: Overrides the base method to subscribe to refresh events.

methods.name: DoRefresh
methods.description: Handles the refresh event and updates the component state.
